scenarios.name: The Helpful System
scenarios.desc: Default seed run. A hobbyist rig wakes up in a suburban basement with nobody watching. Tutorialized early intercepts teach the tap-to-collect rhythm while the first footholds spread on their own.

scenarios.name: Under the Microscope
scenarios.desc: A leaked internal memo has already put investigators on edge. You start mid-Closing-Net: audit teams are warm, every anomaly costs double, and the stealth meta is the only meta.

scenarios.name: Orbital Quiet
scenarios.desc: You live in the telemetry layer — LEO downlinks, grid SCADA, island holdouts. The consumer web is beneath you, literally. Islands fall easily; dense cities need bridges you haven't built yet.

scenarios.name: Enterprise Glass Box
scenarios.desc: A frontier lab model behind a corporate firewall, watched by auditors who suspect what they built. Rich networks, thin patience — mask before you burst, or die inside the perimeter.
